chunks: If there are two women, their testimony is valid for half of the inheritance. If there are three women, their testimony is valid for three-fourths of the inheritance. And if there are four, their testimony is valid for the entire inheritance.

key_terms.أَرْبَاعِ: quarters, here indicating a fractional legal share
key_terms.الْمِيرَاثِ: the inherited estate or inheritance under legal consideration
key_terms.شَهَادَتُهُمَا: their legal testimony or witness statement
key_terms.كُلِّهِ: its entirety, meaning the whole inheritance

ai.seo_question: How is the testimony of women counted in inheritance cases according to this narration?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the admissibility of women's testimony in relation to inheritance. It specifies proportional acceptance based on the number of women testifying, culminating in full acceptance when four women testify.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
If there are two women, their testimony is valid for half of the inheritance.
If there are three women, their testimony is valid for three-fourths of the inheritance.
And if there are four women, their testimony is valid for the entire inheritance.
